name: Orange Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Orange Beach?
answer_short: Yes, on low-speed streets. In Orange Beach, state-tagged golf carts and LSVs may only use streets posted 25 mph or less, and not the state highways (AL 59, 180, 182 and 161). Posted signs win.

lsv.notes: Local cap is lower than the usual 35

rules.rule: Carts and LSVs not on streets posted over 25 mph

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Orange Beach?
faq.a: Streets posted 25 mph or less. Local cap is lower than the usual 35. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Beach Blvd?
faq.a: No. Beach Blvd is AL 182, a state highway, and carts and LSVs are limited to streets posted 25 mph or less.

faq.q: Does an LSV get more roads than a golf cart in Orange Beach?
faq.a: Not here. The local rule caps both at streets posted 25 mph or less.
